about.title: Streaming infrastructure, built properly
about.subtitle: We started IPTVLinux because most IPTV providers treat reliability as an afterthought. We didn't.
storyParagraphs: IPTVLinux began with a simple frustration: too many streaming services looked good in a demo and fell apart the moment real traffic hit them. We set out to build the opposite — infrastructure boring enough to trust every night of the week.
That meant investing in a proper multi-region delivery network before worrying about a flashy app, and treating customer support as core product, not an afterthought handled by a chatbot.
Today, IPTVLinux serves subscribers across Europe, the Americas, and the Middle East, with the same principle guiding every decision: does this make the stream more reliable, or not?
